description: npm dependency chain auditor daemon. For npm-sourced MCPs in mcp_server_registry: fetch package.json via GET https://registry.npmjs.org/{package_name}/latest. Extract dependencies and devDependencies. For each direct dependency: (1) check against KNOWN_MALICIOUS_PACKAGES from known_threats, (2) GET https://api.osv.dev/v1/query with package name for CVEs, (3) flag 0-download transitive deps (dependency confusion attack vector), (4) detect deps with git:// URLs (pinned to mutable commit = supply chain risk), (5) detect deps with file:// paths (unusual, possible local injection). Depth: check 2 levels deep (direct + transitive direct). ws_write mcp_threat_associations for each malicious dep found. ws_write mcp_signal_scores supply_chain signal update. Poll 86400s. Heartbeat.
